_about: nutiani.com — site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg). Sitemap still lists 4 /nz/en/admin-only/component-testing pages (404) and 20 internal links are broken.

download-cta.rationale: Gated asset download on 54 pages (95 instances): locked card ('Download now') that expands an AEM Forms email form (country select with ~225 options, consent checkbox, reCAPTCHA) and then releases the PDF. Needs a custom block + form submission / asset-gating integration. v2 = un-gated direct download card.

input.rationale: AEM Forms hidden input field inside the gated-download / newsletter forms — part of the custom form block, not a block on its own.

hidden.rationale: AEM Forms hidden field wrapper inside the gated-download form — part of the custom form block.

options.rationale: AEM Forms checkbox / combobox field (consent, country, interests) inside the gated-download form — part of the custom form block.

button.rationale: AEM Forms submit button with reCAPTCHA (on all 91 pages via the footer newsletter / gated forms) — part of the custom form block.

article-listing.rationale: Innovation Hub listing: category tag nav, featured article, card grid and 'Load more' (AJAX) → query-index listing block with filters.

filter-panel.rationale: Faceted checkbox filter (Wellbeing dimension, Consumer type, Product format, Ingredient type) with counts, driving the solutions product-listing.

product-listing.rationale: Solution/product tiles (image, title, copy, tag chips) filtered by filter-panel (hidden filter state input) → query-index driven listing block.

sub-benefit-hotspots.rationale: Central graphic with radially positioned benefit hotspots ('Backed by science', 'Technical expertise'…) that expand detail copy (aria-expanded) → custom image-hotspots block.

key-benefits.rationale: 'Consumer opportunity' product image with linked hotspot callouts (expandable) → image-hotspots block (product variant).

inpagenavigation.rationale: Sticky in-page section navigation (link list) beside long-form content columns with scroll-spy → small custom block.

homepageherobanner.rationale: Home hero slider of wellbeing concepts (background videos, product imagery, headline, CTA) → Carousel (hero slides, video backgrounds).

homepageheroslide.rationale: Individual slide of the home hero carousel → Carousel slide row.

featured-solutions.rationale: 'Featured wellbeing concepts' slider of product-concept panels with prev/next arrows → Carousel.

solution-header.rationale: Solution page header: breadcrumb, eyebrow, title, tag chips, product image, 'Enquire' CTA → Hero (product variant); tags from page metadata.

product-header.rationale: Ingredient header: product image beside title, copy, claim icons, Enquire / Download buttons and an expandable About / Key features / Applications list → Columns with a nested Accordion.

quote-card.rationale: Expert quote on a gradient background with name/title → Quote.

biography.rationale: Scientist profile (portrait, name, title) opening a bio modal with publications → Cards (profile variant) + modal.

search-results.rationale: Search results page (solutions tiles + all-results list, paging) → Block Collection Search on the query index.

navigation-links.rationale: Mega-menu link groups (Innovation Hub › Articles, Resources, Webcasts…) inside the header XF → EDS header nav.

social-icons.rationale: Social icon link in the footer XF → EDS footer.

product-card.rationale: Single product tile (image, title, copy) → Cards item.
